reason: My regulars know me and pay at the counter or the terminal; I don't need them rating every croissant in public. One bad day in the kitchen and it's on a dish rating forever, and on top I'd pay a transaction fee and teach staff a second system next to my POS.
objection: Per-dish verified reviews could hurt me more than help - one bad rating sticks, and I make about 10,000 a year, so I can't gamble on something that might scare off new guests.
would_change_my_mind: If I could keep dish ratings private, just for me, and use only the regulars and loyalty part with the payment fee no higher than my terminal's.
